items.t: Jim Cramer Rejects UiPath Despite Cheap Valuation, Backs Affirm
items.sum: Cramer called UiPath cheap but lacking catalysts, endorsed Karman and Affirm, warned on Onto and Nio, and favored Regeneron, Vertex and Amgen over Alnylam

items.t: Affirm Holdings (AFRM) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Analysts Trim Multiples
items.sum: The fair value estimate for Affirm Holdings has edged down to US$95.75 from US$97.87, pointing to a slightly more cautious price target in updated models. This aligns with recent analyst commentary that balances strong gross merchandise volume trends and improving profitability against questions around valuation multiples and credit risk. items.t: Affirm Shares Slid Even Though Profit Rose
items.sum: Affirm continued to report stronger numbers while the share price told a very different story. For Affirm shareholders, the loss from the start of the year was 20.4%, including dividends. items.t: Affirm Takes on AI's Checkout Blind Spot With Consumer Reports
items.sum: AFRM and Consumer Reports test an AI shopping framework to expose hidden credit costs and risks, with guided answers outperforming unguided AI responses.

items.t: Affirm Just Dropped 13% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysAffirm fell 13% in a week with no news of its own, as Upstart and SoFi slid too. A hot October inflation report all but locked in a December Fed hike, which would lift Affirm’s funding costs.
